note: WordPress 7.1.5, theme idvetmp-child. Almost no design-system custom properties. Values are computed styles from raw/readings.json and raw/extra-readings.json.

crimson.source: meta theme-color #C6002F; computed color of footer link and author byline, backgroundColor of .category badge (raw/readings.json, raw/extra-readings.json)

ink.source: computed color of article h1 and primary button backgroundColor (raw/readings.json article h1, home primaryButton)

header.source: computed backgroundColor of #top-header and the home featured section (raw/readings.json header, extra home section)

paper.source: computed backgroundColor of newsletter field, contact field, search field, and the menu panel as photographed

slate.source: computed color of body and article caption (raw/readings.json page, extra-readings paragraphs)

muted.source: computed color of image caption and 6 MIN READ meta (raw/extra-readings.json)

fieldBorder.source: computed borderTopColor of contact text field and textarea (raw/extra-readings.json contact)

onDark.source: computed color of header nav link and featured h1 (raw/readings.json navLink, h1 on home)

sans.source: computed fontFamily of body, nav, buttons, fields (document.fonts: Basier loaded)

display.source: computed fontFamily of h1 and featured titles (document.fonts: RoslindaleCondensed 500 loaded)

narrow.source: computed fontFamily of card titles on the home featured row (document.fonts: RoslindaleNarrow 600 loaded)

semibold.source: computed fontWeight of nav links and primary buttons

bold.source: computed fontWeight of category badge and author byline

display.source: computed style of h1 on article, contact, search and the 404 (raw/readings.json)

cardTitle.source: computed style of featured card title link (raw/readings.json bodyLink on home)

heroTitle.source: computed style of home featured card title (raw/readings.json cardTitle)

lead.source: computed style of article lead paragraph (raw/extra-readings.json)

ui.source: computed style of header nav link and primary button (raw/readings.json)

label.source: computed style of category link and author byline (raw/extra-readings.json)

badge.source: computed fontSize 10px and fontWeight 700 of .category.center; line height derived from the 20px badge box minus 8px padding

4.source: computed paddingTop of search field and header wrapper

5.source: computed paddingLeft/Right of primary button and header wrapper

none.source: computed borderRadius of search field and headings

field.source: computed borderRadius of contact text field and textarea

control.source: computed borderRadius of primary button, badge, newsletter field

button.source: measured height of donate amount button and newsletter field

content.source: measured width of article h1 and search section

hairline.source: computed borderTopWidth of contact field and search field

page.source: interior pages photograph as white; body backgroundColor is transparent

focus.source: computed outlineColor of focused search field; outline style is none 0px, so no ring paints
